title: DualWielding NeoForged
description: Using a stonecutter you can convert either a stone or diamond sword to a shield that can be used in the off-hand alongside your main hand (v1.0.1)
body:
[Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/dualwielding)
(V1.0.1) You can turn a sword into a shield using a stonecutter like shown here.![Using the stonecutter to convert a diamond sword into a diamond shield](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a15acb9d3771a98d3508bd995027efaea1593304.png)
It uses a stonecutter so you can use a shield early game with the stone shield.
inspired by: Sword_Noid
